brief:
Caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu is pressing for renewed strikes against Iranian nuclear facilities, citing Israeli fears that Tehran will move its program deeper underground, Al-Monitor reported. The push has created tension between Netanyahu and Israeli military chiefs, who diverge on both the timing and urgency of such action.

The disagreement reflects broader uncertainty within Israel's security establishment over strategy toward Iran's nuclear development. Netanyahu's argument centers on the window of opportunity closing as Iran potentially conceals its program in fortified underground sites, raising the pressure for imminent military action.
dek: Caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu is capitalizing on Israeli fears that Iran will bury its nuclear program deep underground to press for renewed strikes against Tehran.
title: Netanyahu pushes for urgent Iran strikes amid military disagreement
